authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3193 kīṭa explicitly includes Prakrit kīḍa/kīḍiyā worm/insect/ant and modern western kīṛī ant. The simple kiḍ/kiḍiyā responses fit this family with gender/number endings, vowels and retroflex notation retained. The semantic range includes ant; no source gloss is changed. Extra-v and extra-l forms are excluded pending morphology, and local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: kiḍiyā.
